NextItemRules: Oracle rows are the strongest route: the 6.4 released surface names them, and a literal in the 6.3 body must corroborate the row before it is accepted.
A NewName may not repeat inside one type; the sibling stays open rather than taking a numeric suffix.

Virtual rows, interface implementations and contract-family members are renamed as a family (build-rows.py fills ContractFamily; the updater expands it), so a block can grow the map by more rows than the review file holds.
One block is one review file, one --wave run, one checkpoint, one commit.

HardBlockers.Rule: A turn may stop with work left only when every remaining row of the current block carries one of these codes, recorded here with its token. 'Evidence is missing' is not a blocker code; the turn must switch route instead.
